name: Alice
source: A prototype created at the Akinose Group’s Android Research Lab by Souji’s father. Currently, she's in the testing phase, living with Souji to collect experiential data. Her codename was difficult to read and understand (Akinose-android type "LI" 2nd), so they decided to call her “Alice”. Despite being an android, she’s scatterbrained and clumsy, and she speaks in a slow, drawn-out manner.
